initialize.description: First request after spawn. The host passes settings the agent used to read synchronously.

turn.start.description: SessionExecutionPort.sendMessage. Resolves when the turn (and the queue drain it starts) ends. Rejections reach the origin as deliver messages.

turn.steer.description: SessionExecutionPort.steerQueue: deliver waiting steer messages into the running turn.

turn.drain.description: SessionExecutionPort.drainQueue: start queued prompts of an idle session.

turn.headless.description: HeadlessSessionRunPort.run (scheduled jobs, learning reviews). Prokop only today.

revert.description: SessionExecutionPort.revert. Claude/Codex also roll back their native thread.

fork.description: SessionExecutionPort.fork. Claude/Codex also fork their native thread.

ask.resolve.description: The user answered a pending ask. Replaces the three in-process resolution ports (decision 6 A).

harness.status.description: CLI availability and version probe (codexCliAvailable, claudeCliVersion, ...).

models.list.description: Cached model catalog of a CLI harness.

usage.limits.description: Cached plan usage limits of a CLI harness.

shutdown.description: Finish cleanup (close Codex app-server connections) and exit. Sent only with no active turns.

store.session.get.description: Read a session mid-turn. Turn start already carries a snapshot.

store.session.update.description: Update session columns. metadataPatch is shallow-merged in the host, so concurrent writers do not lose keys.

store.session.handoffBrief.description: Frozen brief for the current segment after a harness switch, or null.

store.session.children.description: Child sessions (subagents, workflows) for interrupt cascade.

store.message.create.description: Create a message with an agent-generated ID (upsert by ID).

store.message.getWithParts.description: Read one message and its parts.

store.message.delete.description: Delete a message and its parts.

store.history.effective.description: History after the latest compaction boundary, with handoff brief.

store.part.create.description: Create a part with an agent-generated ID (upsert by ID).

store.part.byCallId.description: Tool part by provider call ID.

store.part.snapshot.description: Persist streamed text/reasoning so far. Deltas themselves travel as deliver part.append.

store.tool.transition.description: Move a tool part through its state machine. The host also derives files-changed notices from it.

store.index.sync.description: Refresh full-text search for a finished message.

store.artifact.page.description: Read a page of stored tool output.

store.commit.description: Atomic checks + writes in one host transaction (plan F3).

native.get.description: Read one native record. Writes go through store.commit.

native.find.description: Reverse lookup, e.g. Codex thread ID to session.

queue.peekSteer.description: Oldest steer message for a running turn. Retire it with queue.delete in store.commit.

queue.add.description: Queue a prompt behind the running turn.

queue.peek.description: Oldest queued prompt of a session.

queue.get.description: One queued prompt, or null once sent or removed by the user.

queue.listSteer.description: Every steer message of a session, oldest first (a run skips rows it already dispatched).

attachment.get.description: Attachment metadata; the agent reads absolutePath directly.

attachment.create.description: Store a tool-produced file (Codex image outputs).

workspace.resolveRoot.description: Resolve the session root: a selected managed worktree replaces the workspace path. Fails when the worktree is unavailable or missing.

workspace.addRoot.description: Persist an extra workspace root granted during a turn.

interaction.removeByToolCallId.description: Delete pending ask rows for a tool call.

interaction.getRequest.description: Read a permission request by request ID.

interaction.resolveRequest.description: Mark a pending request approved or denied. resolved=false: it was no longer pending.

interaction.resolveWithGrant.description: Resolve and persist the remembered grant atomically (F3 approval transactions). A grant failure denies.

interaction.cancelBySession.description: Cancel pending requests of a session.

interaction.listByRoot.description: Pending asks under a root session.

interaction.listRequestsByRoot.description: Pending permission requests under a root session.

interaction.matchGrant.description: Find a remembered grant covering this action.

interaction.control.description: Whether a session has an owner (who may be offline) and whether that owner is connected now.

tool.list.description: Effective tool definitions for a session and workspace. For MCP, `context` captures the session state access was granted for; pass it back on every call.

tool.call.description: Run a host-owned tool. The host re-checks access against `context` before running. Cancel with $/cancel.

sessionSearch.call.description: One SessionSearchHost port call (shared/session-search/host.ts). Typed per op later; the agent-side tool owns validation and the permission ask.

knowledge.apply.description: Apply an approved memory or skill write on the host, which serializes knowledge writes with learning and settings. The agent already validated and asked.

terminal.create.description: Start a detached terminal. terminalId=null: cwd missing or spawn failed.

terminal.get.description: Terminal info, with the current execution cwd.

terminal.list.description: Terminals opened in a workspace path.

terminal.write.description: Write input to a running terminal.

terminal.read.description: Read buffered output from a byte offset.

terminal.setCwd.description: Record the cwd a command left behind.

deliver.description: Broadcast a client wire message. seq increases by one per deliver, so the host can detect gaps and keep part.append deltas in order.

origin.attach.description: OriginRegistryPort.attachOriginToSession: the origin connection now participates in the session.

session.activity.description: The agent's isSessionActive changed outside a host request (e.g. Codex child turns). The host combines it with its in-flight requests.

host.notify.description: Side effects the host owns: push notifications and file-change notices.

absolutePath.description: Same machine: the agent reads the file directly.

id.description: ID of the in-flight request to cancel.

value.description: Every listed field must equal the stored value field.

ids.description: The transcript, in order, is exactly these messages (unchanged since the agent read it).

harness.description: The session exists and is still owned by this harness.

id.description: A queued prompt is still waiting (not removed by the user).

metadataPatch.description: Shallow-merged into current metadata inside the transaction, replacing agent-side read-modify-write.

handoffBrief.description: Frozen brief for the current segment after a harness switch.

sessionId.description: Owning session; rows are deleted with it.

messageId.description: Owning message; rows are deleted with it.

lookup.description: Unique per harness + kind; reverse lookup such as a Codex thread ID.

blocksSwitch.description: While present, the host refuses a harness switch for the session.

value.description: Opaque to the host, except kind "model" ({ model, effort }).

ToolContext.description: Session state captured when MCP access was granted; a change revokes access.

ToolSource.description: mcp: global and workspace MCP servers. domain: memory, skills, session search, scheduler.

path.description: Resolved session root (managed worktree or workspace path).

allowedRoots.description: Read-only roots: uploads and the agent directory.

origin.description: The host request this delivery belongs to: the host routes it through that request's connection context.

status.description: Denied when the grant could not be stored.

results.description: One entry per write: the stored entity for create/update, true for delete/put.

message.description: Why a write failed (constraint, missing row); for logs only.

snapshot.description: Not sent yet: in Phase 1 harnesses read the session through store.*.

knowledgeRoot.description: Workspace whose memory and skills the resolved path shares (a managed worktree maps to its main workspace).
